Our doubt is that we have photos of cameras, then we transform them to Tiff format, but I think it is too heavy (37.7 MB) for RStudio and therefore does not run.

We do not have experience of image processing in R, therefore we are asking for help to upload the photo and then follow the steps of the manual on Github
I can not upload the photo for the size

From already thank you very much


Seba and Gaston

messages.author: c59b667c61f258ae
messages.subject: Re: Counting the number of objects (e.g. plants, seeds, etc)
parts:
Hi Seba and Gaston,

Thank you for asking. FIELDimageR use as base the package "raster" with allows work with different images formats (e.g. jpg, tif, png, etc). 

My guessing is when you change the format from JPG to Tiff you are losing important configurations in your images and the software can't read it. 

What about you try to use the original format and see if it works better.

Also, you can reduce the image resolution using the function aggregate: https://github.com/OpenDroneMap/FIELDimageR#P20

new_image<-aggregate(previous_image, fact=4)

Let me know if it worked,
Filipe
